_doc: Timmy — the brief savior store manager who accepts Todd as an hourly team lead after the overnight step-down, restoring a shred of workplace dignity. Genuinely compassionate; the rarest archetype the machine produces. His promotion out of the store is not a betrayal — he earned it — but it leaves Todd exposed to whatever comes next. Dialogue-only.
name: Timmy
title: Store Manager
samplePhrase: You did the hard thing. Now let's make sure you get to do the next thing.
